entries: You know the {@spell druidcraft} cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell entangle} spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the {@spell spike growth} spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Casting these spells with this trait doesn't require material components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
entries.name: Child of the Wood

entries: Ability checks made to track you have disadvantage, and you can move across {@quickref difficult terrain||3} made of nonmagical plants and undergrowth without expending extra movement.
entries.name: Timberwalk
